semantics.authority: context-only; never changes historical qualification, frozen watchlist, or trading authority
semantics.price_context: regular-session broad market/sector/rates/volatility/credit/currency/commodity/crypto proxies sampled through yfinance
semantics.extended_hours_context: a separate context-only pre/post-market + futures/crypto snapshot is collected while the US cash session is closed; it is never mixed into regular-session qualification
semantics.event_context: Federal Reserve RSS is prospective context; SEC latest-filings feed is enabled only when ARGUS_SEC_USER_AGENT is configured
semantics.causality: no causal relationship to any security is asserted until separately tested historically/prospectively

historical_replay_recovery.note: Exact replay mismatch remains audit evidence; surviving frozen authority untouched.

risk_coverage.rule: Missing risk is UNKNOWN/null, never zero-risk.

semantics.authority: rolling observational universe only; no same-session promotion
semantics.recovery: provider-revision exact replay mismatch quarantined; conservative virtual prior + protected scanned symbols

service_health.authority: observational services only; frozen V4.78 historical qualification remains authoritative
run_all_flow: continuous context including separate extended-hours snapshot
live-session intake throttled so paper execution gets network priority
preopen/live restart uses asynchronous service boot
off-market intake accelerates for next-session examination

notes.price_freshness_semantics: Current price is display-only. Controller 5m marks are DELAYED for up to 12 minutes during market hours; older or non-market marks are STALE. Outside market hours only a near-close observation may be labeled LAST CLOSE. UI live-quote success may upgrade display to LIVE without changing authority.
notes.rolling_risk_semantics: Rolling risk fields are observational display metadata from the current 60d/5m train-holdout scan. Missing risk is explicit and never treated as zero risk or promotion authority.
notes.sequence_semantics: Loss-streak, payoff and conditional-loss metrics are chronological holdout telemetry only. They do not disable a direction and do not change historical/R4 qualification authority.
notes.edge_semantics: Pair edges outside Direction are shared-pattern membership or exact same-time same-direction mover co-occurrence; no causal relationship is asserted.
notes.direction_semantics: Direction uses qualified pattern hyperedges: each synthetic hub is one qualified pattern and spokes connect its actual member symbols. No symbol-to-symbol causal edge is implied.
notes.qualification_semantics: Qualified means historical V4.78 statistical/economic gates passed; not a guaranteed trade.
notes.risk_asymmetry_semantics: R4 risk-positive means historical holdout expected net return is strictly greater than reconstructed holdout 75th-percentile maximum adverse excursion plus estimated round-trip cost. The existing positive expected-net gate must also pass. Equality fails. The glow is a visualization of this asymmetry, not a guarantee.
notes.legacy_semantics: Legacy means the original V4.78 qualified authority is preserved after historical rehydration. Exact replays and provider-revised replays remain explicitly tagged; future evidence builds forward without rewriting legacy metrics.
notes.hot_semantics: Hot is a visualization rule only: net>=5%, directional>=80%, holdout_n>=12, q<=0.05. It does not promote a trade.
notes.conflict_semantics: Conflict means a symbol currently has historically qualified RISE and FALL patterns. It is diagnostic, not a trade direction.
notes.fire_rate_semantics: For a qualified symbol, 60-day fire rate reconstructs its selected best qualified CORE/FLOW/FULL signature from raw mover-event signatures and counts distinct observed market dates on which that exact family+signature+direction fired at least once in the latest up-to-60 observed market-day window. Repeated intraday fires count once. Unqualified symbols fall back to any mover-event day. Frequency is not quality or causality.
notes.expanded_universe_semantics: Magnitude is raw observed mover size, Frequency is distinct observed fire-day density, Generalization is train-vs-holdout hit-rate agreement, and Immediacy is the inverse normalized horizon of the strongest-net historical candidate. These are observational lenses, not additional qualification gates.
notes.sector_gravity_semantics: Sector gravity uses Nasdaq screener sector metadata when available, cached outside research authority. Larger observed sectors have greater visual mass; this never changes qualification or trading authority.
notes.market_context_semantics: Market context is an independent observational stream of broad-market/risk proxies and official event feeds. It never changes historical qualification, frozen watchlists, or trading authority until separately tested.
notes.universe_intake_semantics: Universe Intake V4 continuously refreshes listed-symbol discovery and rolling 60d/5m grading. Promotion uses a persistent one-shot BY hypothesis ledger, freezes passing rules before prospective evidence, and records post-freeze validation. It never rewrites frozen V4.78 historical authority.
notes.selected_security_semantics: Selected-security price is the freshest observed mark available to the publisher, preferring controller live 5m snapshots, then paper exit/entry marks, then rolling universe-scan price. The UI may attempt a display-only live quote and labels its timestamp/source. Paper record counts completed wins/losses from realized net_pct plus currently open paper positions. R4 risk fields show expected net versus p75 MAE+cost and never rewrite historical authority.
notes.write_safety: Publisher reads completed checkpoints plus independent observational streams and never mutates Argus research artifacts.
